correctness.summary: The block-order construction reduces failure at each Y-vertex to one relative order of d neighbours, of probability 1/d!. Neighbourhood overlap gives a valid dependency graph, the symmetric Lovasz local lemma avoids all failures, and palette equality/inequality covers every edge. The d-regular corollary follows from Delta(J) <= d(d-1) and a checked factorial inequality starting at d=5.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The directly relevant 2026 preprint states a general degree-at-least-six result, while indexed descriptions identify regular degrees 3, 4, and 5 as remaining. Exact and synonymous searches found no coverage of the bipartite degree-5 theorem or the neighbourhood-overlap criterion. The full source manuscript was not inspected, leaving a concrete residual risk from an unindexed remark or very recent parallel work.

value.summary: The result closes the entire properly edge-coloured 5-regular bipartite subcase of a newly stated conjecture and supplies a reusable local criterion for broader bipartite graphs.

limitations: The general 3-regular and 4-regular cases remain open.
The local-lemma threshold is sufficient, not claimed sharp.
The full text of the directly relevant 2026 preprint was not inspected.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
